page.title: Webhook forwarding
page.description: The platform operator's list of services that receive a copy of every Meta webhook.
page.banner: Meta allows one callback URL. We receive it once, verify it, and forward the raw body unchanged (with the original signature) to every active target.
page.superOnly: Only a super admin can manage webhook forwarding.

targets.emptyBody: Add a target to start forwarding Meta webhooks to another service.

targets.pendingLabel: {count, number} failed deliveries waiting for replay
targets.testOk: Test passed: status {status} in {ms, number} ms
targets.deleteBody: The target stops receiving webhooks and its kept failed deliveries are deleted. This cannot be undone.
